Rating: ExplicitLanguage: EnglishWords: 41,253Chapters: 19/?Kudos: 195

Summary: The bite mark at the base of Stiles’s neck—where his shoulder met the curve of his throat—burned with a dull, hollow ache. It was Derek’s mark, the exact shape of his teeth healed into a pale, permanent seal of their bond. Except now, the bond on the other side of it was pitch-black and dead. "Scott, please. Listen to me," he choked out, tears finally breaking past his lashes. "Derek is dead. They killed him. And Peter is gone—he’s locked in Eichen House! Don't you see what's happening? It’s Theo! He’s doing this!" Cornered with no way out, Stiles took a step backward into the empty air and threw himself off the cliff. As he plunged into the abyss, gravity pulling him down toward the jagged rocks below, a brilliant, blinding electric purpleburst into Stiles’s eyes, illuminating the dark canyon wall. His voice echoed through the air, resonant and powerful with the ancient force of his dying Spark: "If I can do it all again... I would never trust Scott. I'll make sure this never happens." Stiles slammed into the rocks below, and the world went pitch black.

Summary: Derek Hale's dream was owning a restaurant. When a call came in warning Derek about his uncle passing away, and about a very generous inheritance which included not only an apartment in his hometown, or extremely abundant bank accounts, but a restaurant, Derek didn't see how he could refuse. entry.title: Gas Station Roses

Author: Definitively_Different_Drivel

Rating: General AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 1,694Chapters: 1/1Kudos: 64

Summary: He'd always leave a single rose from the prior week behind. Sometimes, it'd be under the windshield wiper on the jeep. Sometimes it'd be on his door handle. Sometimes, on the rare occasions when Stiles left the car unlocked, it'd be tucked away inside Roscoe. Sometimes, when Stiles wasn't paying attention, Derek would find a way to stick it into Stiles' work apron as Stiles craned his neck around to catch sight of a different customer. The weirdest part? Derek always left them with last week's cash wrapped tightly around the stem. The first few weeks Stiles felt flattered. Derek's glares did nothing to detract from his burning-hot exterior while the roses spoke to the soul of a romantic. Those first few weeks, Stiles tried to make small talk. He smiled, he joked, he pulled out all the damn stops to try to charm his handsome benefactor to no avail. Stony silences and gruff glares wore Stiles down until their weekly exchange proceeded clinically, like clockwork. The door swung shut as Derek stalked into the night, baffling as ever.Derek sends mixed signals till a run-in with hunters helps Derek realize that maybe he doesn't have to do the protecting.

entry.title: You saw me when I was invisible
entry.summary:
Author: MackJLee9

Rating: Teen And Up AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 87,231Chapters: 6/?Kudos: 368

Summary: Matt stood there next to him, red solo cup in hand, and his camera dangled from the strap around his neck. "You know what your problem is?" Stiles felt his eyes slightly widen, taken aback because what the fuck does that mean? "Interesting way to greet someone, dude," He tried to sound playful, but he was slightly annoyed now, so he was sure that was noticeable in his voice and expression. Matt ignored his comment completely and turned around to look outside through the open sliding door, pointing a finger toward it with the hand still around his cup. Stiles looked over his shoulder at what —who— Matt was pointing at. Scott stood there, talking and laughing with Liam, who had made his way outside without him noticing. Liam's friends, Corey, Mason and Hayden, were there too, accompanied by Isaac, who dragged Boyd and Erica along. Then there were Danny and Jackson, with Lydia huddled close to Allison. "You're their DUFF." "Their what?" "DUFF— designated ugly fat friend," Stiles stayed silent and shifted his gaze back to the friend group outside, "You and I? We make them look better, more popular, more desirable." All Stiles could do was laugh.
